title.list_db_policies: List row policies, quotas and settings profiles

consent.create_cloud_project: Create a new SnoutData Cloud project (a hosted database) on your account.
consent.start_cloud_project: Start a paused SnoutData Cloud project.
consent.delete_cloud_project: Delete a SnoutData Cloud project and its data, and remove its connection.
consent.set_cloud_product: Turn a SnoutData Cloud product (auth, storage or data API) on or off for a project.
consent.remove_cloud_secret: Remove an environment secret from a SnoutData Cloud project's functions.
consent.size_cloud_function: Change the memory and number of workers of a SnoutData Cloud function.
consent.export_cloud_project: Take a pg_dump export of a SnoutData Cloud project.
consent.reset_cloud_password: Reset a SnoutData Cloud project's database password (other clients need the new user name and password once the old one stops working).
consent.test_connection_settings: Try connecting to a database that is not saved, at the address shown.
consent.open_connection_form: Open the new-connection form, filled in for you to check and save.
consent.get_connection: Read one saved connection's settings (never its password).
consent.edit_connection: Change the settings of a saved connection.
consent.connect: Connect to one of your saved databases.
consent.insert_sql: Type SQL into the editor you are looking at.
consent.open_in_new_tab: Open a new editor tab with SQL in it.
consent.run_current: Run the query in the editor.
consent.run_data_flow: Run one of your data flows now, which writes to its destination.
consent.remember_this: Remember a fact about your database for future conversations.
consent.add_monitor_widget: Add a widget to one of your monitors.
consent.remove_monitor_widget: Remove a widget from one of your monitors.
consent.delete_monitor: Delete a monitor, and the history it has collected.
consent.open_table_designer: Open the table designer with a proposed table for you to review.
consent.propose_db_user: Open the new-user form, filled in for you to review. Nothing runs until you approve it.
consent.propose_db_access_change: Open the privileges review screen with these statements. Nothing runs until you approve it.
consent.set_setting: Change one of your app settings.
consent.create_tunnel: Create a saved SSH tunnel (without its password or passphrase).
consent.edit_tunnel: Change a saved SSH tunnel, which affects every connection using it.
consent.save_workspace_file: Save SQL to a file in your workspace, overwriting one of the same name.
consent.open_workspace_file: Open one of your workspace .sql files.
